newsitem.title: USA: Georgia-Pacific to post $80 million gain in second quarter.
newsitem.headline: Georgia-Pacific to post $80 million gain in second quarter.

text.p: Georgia-Pacific West Inc. said Thursday it will post an after-tax gain of about $80 million in the second quarter of 1997 from the sale of its Martell, Calif.-based operations.
The sale, to Sierra Pacific Holding Co. for about $320 million, is expected to close in the same quarter, it said.

Georgia-Pacific, a wholly owned subsidiary of Georgia-Pacific Corp., bought the 127,000-acre operation in 1988 for an undisclosed price. The site, about 50 miles southeast of Sacramento, Calif. produces Western soft lumber and includes a particleboard operation.
Atlanta-based Georgia-Pacific's stock closed Tuesday at $70.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
